item.text:
Created a complete Rust 2021 project in `/output` with the root binary [test9.rs](/output/test9.rs), library modules [color_space.rs](/output/src/color_space.rs) and [cpp_float.rs](/output/src/cpp_float.rs), plus [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml). The port preserves the C++ CLI behavior exactly: same defaults, same `argc` thresholds, HSL-based saturation adjustment, and C++-style `std::cout` float formatting.

It compiles both ways: `rustc --edition 2021 /output/test9.rs -o /output/test9` and `cargo build --release` in `/output`. I compared `/output/test9` against `/workspace/dataset/test9_executable` on the provided examples, partial-argument cases, special values, and 200 generated cases; all outputs matched byte-for-byte.
